scope: standalone Commerce SQLite only; Veloce host integration remains open

commerce_sources.policy: active at most 28 days; hidden at original expiry; text redacted after 7 recovery days; identifier/hash skeleton retained

commerce_proposals.policy: active at most 28 days, no later than sources; scope and description redacted after 7 recovery days; digest/money/reference skeleton retained; immutable rejected-draft correction lineage keeps original clock and prevents duplicate successors

commerce_approvals.policy: original execution expiry enforced; identity/digest evidence retained pending financial policy; never reactivated by purge

commerce_intents.policy: retained pending owner policy; expired checkout URL hidden immediately and erased after 7 recovery days

commerce_operations.policy: stable claim/operation identifiers retained pending owner policy

commerce_orders.policy: provider order mapping retained pending owner policy

commerce_captures.policy: provider capture mapping retained pending owner policy

commerce_payment_inbox.policy: event id/hash/disposition only; retained pending owner policy; raw event body not persisted; tenant attribution for new mapped events; legacy unattributed processed rows block export

commerce_kickoff_outbox.policy: intent/state only; retained pending owner policy; held on proposal content purge

commerce_projects.policy: inherits proposal expiry; title/tasks redacted after 7 recovery days; held identifier skeleton retained

commerce_draft_runs.policy: no source/prompt/output body; model metadata redacted at 35 days; id/status/subject skeleton retained pending lifecycle completion

commerce_proposal_decisions.policy: reason redacted with proposal after 7 recovery days; actor/decision/reference retained pending financial policy

commerce_users.policy: private verifier records; operator revocation supported; full offboarding remains open

commerce_sessions.policy: hashed tokens; 1 hour expiry enforced; logout/revocation remove tokens; expired rows removed at login

commerce_login_limits.policy: hashed buckets; 15 minute expiry; expired rows removed at login attempt

commerce_revoked_approvals.policy: permanent denial of approvals imported by protected restore; retained pending financial policy

commerce_workspace_restores.policy: snapshot digest/time only; prevents repeated restore into the same tenant; retained pending lifecycle policy
